findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 second, so existing callers that rely on the previous behavior now get a 1-second floor on every wait they compute.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an existing caller uses wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1) or any initial below 1 without passing min. Mechanism: the return value is now max(max(0, self.min), ...) with self.min=1, so early retries wait at least 1s instead of about 0.1s. Impact: retry timing silently changes for upgraded users, making retries slower than configured and possibly breaking tests or latency budgets.
